svg.title: Bench readouts
svg.text: MPX SPIN V1 (CONCEPT 04 DEVELOPED) · DESIGN REVIEW

text.tspan: Two live charts, the requirement checks for the current settings, and the microscope's view of the sleeve.

svg.text: SPIN V1, 1,500 RPM, VANES, GRADE 602 H

text.tspan: The rig passes flow, face velocity and stress, but fails capture, sleeve life, water speed, the wet-path
rule and the interlock. Spin v1 passes all but the 1–2 µm band (89 %).

svg.text: PD-298 · Team MPx · CPDM, IISc · Oct 2026
